title: Gospel direct speech
subtitle: Separate narration, speaker, and quoted words.
overview: Gospel narrative often alternates rapidly between action and speech. Mark the reporting verb, its speaker, and the exact speech boundary.
Questions and imperatives inside quotation retain their own grammar; do not let the outer narrative verb control them.

items.grc: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· τί ἐστιν εὔκοπον εἰπεῖν;
items.en: Jesus says to him, “Which is easier to say?”

items.grc: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· δεῦτε ὀπίσω μου.
items.en: And he said to them, “Come after me.”
